unseen_family_limitation_note: Under a strictly global chronological split across CICIDS2017, attack families scheduled on later days (validation/test) do not appear in earlier-day training. Exact multiclass recall on unseen attack families is 0.0 by construction; binary attack ROC-AUC/PR-AUC measures only benign-vs-attack feature separability, not unseen-family classification.

binary_detection.caveat: Binary attack detection (1 - P(BENIGN)) can flag unseen attacks resembling seen families, which does NOT imply correct multiclass family attribution.
